description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Lexer_PEARSax3, which implements a lexer for parsing HTML using the PEAR XML_HTMLSax3 SAX parser. The class handles HTML tokenization by setting up event handlers for opening tags, closing tags, text data, and escaped content, and it manages internal tokens accordingly.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer_PEARSax3
classes.description: A lexer class that utilizes the PEAR XML_HTMLSax3 parser to tokenize HTML content into a sequence of tokens.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Main method that normalizes input HTML string, sets up the PEAR SAX parser with handlers, and returns the list of tokens after parsing.

methods.name: openHandler
methods.description: Handles start element events; processes attributes and creates corresponding token objects.

methods.name: closeHandler
methods.description: Handles end element events; creates end tag token or ignores if due to parser quirks.

methods.name: dataHandler
methods.description: Handles text data within elements; creates text token objects.

methods.name: escapeHandler
methods.description: Handles escaped content such as comments; creates comment tokens when applicable.
